song: 13 - Oyelo Que Te Conviene (canta： Lalo Rodriguez)
title: papaya curtains closing the band
story: Oyelo's salsa (136 bpm tracker beat) plays a steady groove under the curtains: every two beats they close and open, the colour sways per bar, and the bright strokes flash the centre curtain while the open tones lift brightness. At the KEY turn (12076) the palette steps, and the final cierre (12137-12187) lifts every band with rising contrast, the last hit the strongest. The decay then lets the bands go out from the outside in, one per beat, until one thin coral thread remains with the last sound.
